author: Mail Triage
name: Webhook notifications
description: Posts a JSON event to a webhook URL (ntfy, Home Assistant, your own endpoint) when mail is filed by a rule/flow or classified. Set the URL and allowed host in the plugin's settings.

events.description: Event types to send: mail.filed, mail.classified

allowed_hosts.description: Host patterns for the URL above (e.g. ntfy.sh, 127.0.0.1, *.example.com)
